svg.text: Rocker H (G with 94 mm bottom arm) — print version. Right side of bike, front to the right (same view as your photos)
Arm at 20° full droop, XR250R shock 380 / 95. All sizes mm. All rocker holes 10.8 (M10 + 0.8). 1:1 DXF and SVG files sit next to this drawing.
• 215 mm wheel travel, ratio 2.37 falling to 2.18 (about 9% rising rate)
• Dogbone never closer than 85° to the rocker: no lock-out
• Later: same rocker with a 380 / 120 custom shock gives about 269 mm (130 stroke: about 291)
• The notch and dip are cut from my CRF250 arm model and a guessed
clevis. Top half is unchanged from F, which fitted; only the bottom arm is new.
• Lug per your tape: 150 behind / 47 below the XL lower bolt at full droop.
• Plate: 16 mm thick to fit the XR clevis gap (check yours).
